title: Code-tidying team config
description: Schema for <home>/code-tidying.yaml, the team layer of the code-tidying plugin's settings, and its personal override code-tidying.local.yaml for the comment keys. A comment key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name; the personal override wins over the team file. Comment keys and resolution: the Settings section of skills/remove-comments/SKILL.md. Upkeep keys: plugins/code-tidying/reference/config.md.

comment_posture.description: Which comments /code-tidying:remove-comments keeps. auto: explanatory, or necessary in a pull-request pipeline run. none: only machine-read directives, license headers, TODO(#issue) markers, paired records and public-API doc comments stay. necessary: also verified outside-constraint comments. explanatory: every comment that passes the earn-its-keep test. Deprecated, still resolved: strict and balanced read as explanatory, conservative as explanatory plus safe, aggressive as necessary.

comment_edit_scope.description: On the uncommitted and branch scope rungs, diff triages only comments on the lines the change adds; files triages every comment in each changed file.

encode_constraints_unattended.description: Whether an unattended remove-comments run may encode a constraint comment as a test, assertion or lint rule without asking. Off: the encoding is offered in the report.

class_c_max_lines.description: Lines a kept comment may run before remove-comments rewrites it terser.

apply_local_renames.description: Whether a function-local rename certified RENAME-ONLY applies without a test net.

upkeep_cadence.description: How often an upkeep batch may open pull requests.

upkeep_backstop.description: An area changed since its last sweep is overdue once its oldest unswept commit is older than this window, and goes ahead of other changed areas. An unchanged area is never swept.

upkeep_max_open.description: At most this many chore/tidy-* pull requests open at once: /code-tidying:tidy stops at it, and an upkeep batch opens only the difference.

upkeep_spec_issue.description: The issue holding the upkeep sweep's contract. Each upkeep batch pull request's body opens with `Refs: #<this>`, the spec a verifier judges it against. No default: a batch with none set opens no pull request.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example batch-simplify); an entry beats this file's verification value.
